decision.rationale: The disputed charge is TXN-008022: 54.35 EUR on card CRD-000028 at Ashgrove Athletic Club (MER-000063), a recurring-billing fitness merchant. It was charged on 2026-08-29 and posted on 2026-08-30. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 55 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The cardholder says they cancelled by phone but has nothing in writing. No cancellation confirmation from the merchant is attached, so there is no effective cancellation date to compare with the charge date. The cardholder's account of a phone call is a claim, not written confirmation. Under recurring-no-proof, we ask the merchant for its cancellation records and the terms of the subscription.

proposed_actions.note: For the subscription charge of 54.35 EUR made on 2026-08-29, please send your cancellation records for this cardholder's subscription, including any record of a cancellation request made by phone and the date it took effect. Please also send the cancellation terms that applied to the subscription.
